preflight: all locked races must be complete and out of sample before feature snapshots; reject a pre-existing report before opening the results door

training.source: complete feature-only RACE_END snapshots; transition labels derive from lap-end cutoffs

randomness.pace_fit_seed_scope: shared by every driver at one race and cutoff

cutoffs: every integer cutoff from zero through scheduled_laps minus one, in race and lap order
target_mask: one available best-action finish distribution per driver and cutoff snapshot
join the frozen prediction to that driver's final classification; unclassified starters count as failures for podium and top-ten scores
finish-interval coverage is evaluated only for classified finishers
freeze all race/cutoff/driver predictions before requesting final classifications

metrics.podium_brier: binary final_position <= 3; unclassified starters count as failures; average within race then weight races equally
metrics.top10_brier: binary final_position <= 10; unclassified starters count as failures; average within race then weight races equally
metrics.finish_interval_90: inclusive empirical inverted-CDF P05/P95 endpoints; coverage only for classified finishers
metrics.strategy_agreement: top action begins with pit, matched to each observed pit event's latest prior not-yet-visible recommendation
metrics.aggregation: equal race weight after within-race observation means
metrics.empty_race_rule: preserve every locked race row with zero or unavailable denominators

report_schema.required_race_rows: one ordered row for every locked 2026 race
report_schema.required_denominators: podium/top-ten driver-cutoff counts, classified-finisher interval counts, and observed/matched stop counts are explicit overall and per race

result_access: OutOfSampleAccessor.final_classification is called only after predictions for all locked races are frozen
score_policy: score once and never tune or rescore against the holdout

lock_digest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, omitting lock_digest
